description: This file defines a FastAPI application with a data model 'Item' using Pydantic and an endpoint for updating items via HTTP PUT.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: A Pydantic data model representing an item with optional description and tax fields.

methods.name: update_item(item_id: int, item: Item, q: str | None = None)
methods.description: Asynchronous handler function for HTTP PUT requests to update an item with provided item data and optional query parameter 'q'.

ctags.name: update_item
ctags.pattern: /^async def update_item(item_id: int, item: Item, q: str | None = None):$/
ctags.signature: (item_id: int, item: Item, q: str | None = None)
